# Avenue Constructions Ltd

> Premier Real Estate Developer & Architectural Atelier in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Specializing in bespoke single-unit luxury residential towers and landowner joint venture developments.

## Overview

Avenue Constructions Ltd is a Dhaka-based real estate development company engineering institutional-grade residential landmarks across Dhaka's most prestigious enclaves, including Bashundhara R/A, Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, and Aftabnagar.

- **Website:** https://avenueconstructionsltd.com
- **Headquarters:** Resourceful Paltan City, 51, 51/A (7th Floor), Purana Paltan, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
- **Phone:** +880 1714 767 246 / +880 1581 742 235
- **Email:** avenueconstructionlimited@gmail.com
- **Engineering Standard:** 100% RAJUK Sanctioned, IEB (Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh) certified structural design, BSRM 500W rebar, Holcim cement, stone chips casting.

## Signature Capabilities

1. **Single-Unit Luxury Residences:**
   - One exclusive apartment per floor providing total acoustic isolation and 360-degree natural ventilation.
   - Private keycard elevator access directly opening to individual apartment foyers.
   - Floor area sizes typically 2,100 to 2,500+ sq. ft.

2. **Landowner Joint Venture Partnerships:**
   - Ethical, transparent joint-venture ratios for landowners holding freehold plots in Dhaka.
   - Turnkey execution covering soil testing, architectural blueprints, RAJUK clearance, construction escrow, and contractual completion guarantees.

## Signature Projects

- **Avenue Ahsan Palace:**
  - *Location:* Block E, Road 02, Plot 42, Bashundhara R/A, Dhaka (Near Evercare Hospital)
  - *Format:* G+8 Boutique Residential Tower (Single unit per floor, 2,150 sq. ft.)
  - *Features:* South-facing plot, private lift lobby, museum-grade finishes, rooftop sky lounge.

- **Avenue Mohammad Heights:**
  - *Location:* Sector 02, Block G, Road 03, Plot 21, Aftabnagar, Dhaka (Hatirjheel link)
  - *Format:* G+8 Luxury Tower (Single unit per floor, 2,150 sq. ft.)
  - *Features:* Corner plot, lakeside breeze, private security elevator, dedicated parking.

- **Avenue Dream:**
  - *Location:* South Badda, Gulshan Link Corridor, Dhaka
  - *Format:* G+7 Modern Residential Development (14 units)
  - *Features:* Double-height entrance lobby, high-speed elevator, full standby generator.

- **Avenue Castle:**
  - *Location:* Shadhinota Shoroni, Uttar Badda, Dhaka
  - *Format:* G+9 Monolithic Landmark (27 units)
  - *Features:* Cantilevered architecture, earthquake-resilient frame, marble reception lobby.
